playable_character_model.rule: Custom player characters and canonical characters are supported; canon remains protected.

class_system.rule: No mandatory fixed traditional class at character creation; build identity emerges from equipment, skills, progression and choices.

primary_control.rule: Point-and-click / mouse-driven movement and combat interaction is the primary control contract.

development_network_scope.rule: First playable target is single-player; authority/state contracts must not block later multiplayer.

itemization.rule: Own rarity names, sockets and item rules; use genre-proven mathematical structure only as a reference.

art_gate.rule: Concept art/final visual production remains blocked until Stage 17 pre-art gate passes.
